svg.aria-label: Pick the right vendor for the task
svg.title: Pick the right vendor for the task
svg.desc: Pick software for a function given YOUR context: define requirements, research and shortlist the market, compare candidates on judged evidence against the stack you already run, trial the finalists agentically, then security review, negotiation, and a signed agreement. Rollout hands off to the Connect a vendor or MCP server process.
